scope: post hoc supplementary ideal correct-token VQGAN reference on all 100 frozen images
execution_condition: after development model exits, only if at least 12 minutes remain in this hourly window
population: all 100 frozen images; noiseless transmitted token IDs, one deterministic decode per image
interpretation: ideal reference paired with analytic ARQ payload TCE; not an observed retry/feedback protocol
metrics: raw PSNR, normalized clamped LPIPS, clipped PIL CLIP; same weights and conventions as primary
caveats: not one of the six preregistered primary paths
perfect tokens assumed; residual source quantization remains
actual control/coding/side-channel/latency costs excluded from analytic TCE
